en.name: Balsamic vinegar
en.summary: Balsamic vinegar is a dark, sweet, aged vinegar made from cooked grape must. Unopened in the cupboard it keeps about 3–5 years from purchase. Once opened, refrigeration extends it to about 18 months, and the limit in both cases is flavour rather than safety.
en.pantry: A capped bottle in a cool, dark cupboard runs about 3–5 years from the day you buy it. Heat and light are what age it badly — a bottle on a sunny windowsill or beside the hob dulls and flattens long before one at the back of a cupboard. Stand it upright, keep the cap clean, and wipe the neck after pouring, because the sugar in balsamic makes drips sticky and traps dust.
en.fridge: Balsamic is acidic enough not to require refrigeration for safety, but the fridge is what the published figure covers after opening: about 18 months at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, longer than the same bottle would hold its character in a warm kitchen. Cold thickens it slightly and can drop a little sediment, both of which are normal. If you use it daily, a cupboard is perfectly reasonable; if the bottle will sit for a season, the fridge is the better bet.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for balsamic vinegar and no reason to freeze it. Its acidity and sugar already make it stable for years, and freezing a syrupy vinegar achieves nothing except crystallised sugars and cloudiness. Space in the freezer is better spent on something perishable.
spoilage: A genuinely off or solvent-like smell, distinct from balsamic's normal sweet sharpness
Fuzzy mould around the neck or cap, usually where sticky drips were left
Separation into a watery layer and a sludgy one that will not mix back
A flat, dusty taste with none of the original sweetness — old rather than unsafe
tips: Buy the size you will actually use; a small good bottle beats a large dull one.
Wipe the neck after every pour to stop sticky build-up.
Keep it away from the hob and out of direct sunlight.
Sediment in an aged bottle is normal — decant or ignore it.

faq.q: Does balsamic vinegar need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Not for safety. Unopened it keeps about 3–5 years in a cupboard; after opening, the fridge gives it about 18 months of good character.

faq.q: How long does balsamic vinegar last after opening?
faq.a: About 18 months refrigerated at 4 °C or below. In a warm kitchen it fades faster, though it does not become unsafe.
There is no timeline and no reason to. It is stable for years on its own and freezing only clouds it.

faq.q: Why has my balsamic vinegar gone cloudy?
faq.a: Cold and age both drop sediment out of an aged vinegar. It is harmless; pour carefully or decant.

zh.name: 巴薩米克醋
zh.summary: 巴薩米克醋是用煮過的葡萄汁釀造、經過陳年的深色甜醋。未開封放在櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 3～5 年。開封後冷藏可延長到大約 18 個月，而兩者的限制都是風味，不是安全。
zh.pantry: 蓋緊放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 3～5 年。真正傷害它的是熱和光——放在有陽光的窗台或爐邊的那一瓶，會比放在櫥櫃深處的早很多失去層次。請直立擺放、保持瓶蓋乾淨，倒完擦一下瓶口，因為巴薩米克含糖，滴下來會黏、還會沾灰。
zh.fridge: 巴薩米克的酸度足夠，從安全角度看不需要冷藏，但開封後的公布數字講的就是冷藏：4 °C 以下大約 18 個月，比同一瓶放在溫暖廚房裡能維持風味的時間長。低溫會讓它稍微變稠，也可能析出一點沉澱，這兩件事都正常。每天都會用的話，放櫥櫃完全合理；如果一瓶會放上好幾個月，冷藏比較保險。
zh.freezer: 巴薩米克醋沒有冷凍期限，也沒有冷凍的理由。它的酸度和糖分本來就能讓它穩定好幾年，冷凍一瓶濃稠的醋只會讓糖結晶、液體變濁。冷凍庫的空間留給易腐食材比較划算。
spoilage: 真的出現異味，像溶劑味，和巴薩米克原本的甜嗆不同
瓶口或瓶蓋周圍長霉，通常是黏答答的殘液沒擦造成的
分層成清澈的一層和泥狀的一層，而且搖不回去
喝起來扁平無味、完全沒有原本的甜——那是老了，不是不安全
tips: 買你真的用得完的容量；一小瓶好的勝過一大瓶放到走味的。
每次倒完都擦一下瓶口，避免黏垢累積。
遠離爐火，避免陽光直射。
陳年醋有沉澱是正常的——小心倒或先過濾即可。

faq.a: 以安全而言不需要。未開封在櫥櫃大約 3～5 年；開封後冷藏可以維持大約 18 個月的良好風味。

faq.q: 巴薩米克醋開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 冷藏在 4 °C 以下大約 18 個月。放在溫暖的廚房裡會更快走味，但不會變得不安全。

faq.q: 巴薩米克醋可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 沒有對應期限，也沒有必要。它本來就能穩定好幾年，冷凍只會讓它變濁。

faq.q: 巴薩米克醋變混濁怎麼辦？
faq.a: 低溫和陳放都會讓沉澱析出，那是無害的。倒的時候小心一點，或先過濾。
